# Florida Home Value AI

> Parcel-level property tax and home value data for Sarasota, Charlotte and Manatee counties, Florida, built from each county's own certified tax roll rather than national estimates or county averages. Operated by Michael Putnam, Florida Real Estate Sales Associate SL3220671, of Putnam Realty Group, Broker Brian Putnam Jr. BK3276432.

Every figure on this site comes from public records: county certified tax rolls, published millage rates by tax district, and qualified owner-to-owner resales. Builder closings are excluded from sales analysis, because a builder base price is not a comparable sale for an existing home. Automated value estimates are produced by RPR (Realtors Property Resource) and are not appraisals.

Updated: 2026-09-17

## Original research

- [Florida's homestead exemption increase: what 542,376 parcels actually show](https://floridahomevalueai.com/homestead-exemption-study-2026): the November 2026 ballot measure measured against every residential parcel in three counties. Across 317,923 homesteaded parcels, 51 percent would owe no non-school property tax at the full $250,000 exemption, not the 60 percent figure repeated statewide, and the range runs from 6 percent to 73 percent by community. Charlotte County 63 percent, Sarasota 49 percent, Manatee 45 percent. Includes methodology, sources by file and date, and a stated list of weaknesses.

- [Palmer Ranch neighborhood guide](https://floridahomevalueai.com/palmer-ranch): all 24 Palmer Ranch subdivisions with more than 120 parcels, with median assessed value, owner-occupied share, pool share and the share reaching zero tax in 2028. Median assessed values range from $79,444 to $588,977 inside one master-planned development. Sandhill Preserve is 85 percent owner-occupied; Vintage Grand is 16 percent.

- [Sarasota County home value report](https://floridahomevalueai.com/market-report): recorded resales analyzed by community and property type, including a pool premium study across 204 single-family resales in eight communities, size-matched within each community. Median difference about $99,550, roughly 17 percent, against the $30,000 to $50,000 usually quoted nationally.

## Property tax and the November 2026 homestead amendment

- [Southwest Florida property tax calculator](https://floridahomevalueai.com/property-tax-calculator): type any address in Sarasota, Charlotte or Manatee County and see that parcel's own tax bill line by line, before and after the proposed homestead exemption increase. 542,376 residential parcels across 95 separate tax districts. Verified against eight 2026 TRIM notices across four tax districts, matching exactly on non-school taxable value, school taxable value and total millage.

Key facts this calculator establishes, each checkable against the counties' own records:

- The increase applies only to the NON-SCHOOL portion of ad valorem tax. School tax keeps the same $25,000 exemption. On most bills in this area the school line is the larger of the two.
- It does not touch non-ad valorem assessments: CDD, fire, solid waste, stormwater. On one verified Gran Paradiso TRIM notice those came to $2,721 a year.
- Manatee County publishes non-ad valorem assessments per parcel, by name and dollar amount. Sarasota and Charlotte do not. 166,177 Manatee parcels carry a figure, median $389.
- Non-school millage varies by nearly a factor of two across the three counties: unincorporated Sarasota 5.3787 mills, City of North Port 8.4154, Charlotte County district 001 9.3304, unincorporated Manatee 6.9916.
- 224,453 of the 542,376 parcels carry no homestead exemption and get nothing from the increase. 106,499 are owned from out of state.
- A separate deadline matters for anyone relocating: permanent Florida residency by 31 December 2026 qualifies for the full increased exemption from the start. Residency established on or after 1 January 2027 begins at $50,000 and waits until the fifth year.

- [Florida homestead exemption guide](https://floridahomevalueai.com/homestead): what the exemption is, the 1 March filing deadline, portability, and the Save Our Homes 3 percent assessment cap.

## Home values by community

Valuation tools calibrated from recorded sales inside one specific subdivision rather than a ZIP code average:

- [Gran Paradiso, Venice](https://granparadiso.floridahomevalueai.com/) — Lennar, Wellen Park, single-family, coach homes, villas and townhomes
- [IslandWalk, Venice](https://islandwalk.floridahomevalueai.com/) — DiVosta, about 2,000 homes
- [Talon Preserve, Nokomis](https://talonpreserve.floridahomevalueai.com/) — DiVosta, Palmer Ranch, no CDD
- [Palmero, Nokomis](https://palmero.floridahomevalueai.com/) — Taylor Morrison, no CDD

Market data pages, recorded sales and tax figures without a calibrated valuation tool:

- [Grand Palm](https://floridahomevalueai.com/grand-palm) · [Sarasota National](https://floridahomevalueai.com/sarasota-national) · [Renaissance](https://floridahomevalueai.com/renaissance) · [Sunstone](https://floridahomevalueai.com/sunstone) · [Brightmore](https://floridahomevalueai.com/brightmore) · [Sunrise Preserve](https://floridahomevalueai.com/sunrise-preserve)
- [Wellen Park](https://floridahomevalueai.com/wellen-park) · [Palmero compared with Talon Preserve](https://floridahomevalueai.com/palmero-vs-talon-preserve)

## Terms of use for this content

The figures on this site may be cited with attribution to Florida Home Value AI or Michael Putnam, Putnam Realty Group. Nothing here is an appraisal, tax advice or legal advice. Where a figure on this site disagrees with a county record, the county is correct.
